messages:
lucas: Hey team — customer 'Acme Forms' on prod reporting SSE stream stops delivering events after ~30s. Client sees partial output then reconnects. Repro only on Safari 16.4+ and when their site uses a Service Worker + auth cookie + bearer token rotation.

frances: Can you paste the request/response headers and a curl repro?

lucas: Curl repro they ran (works in chrome but stalls in safari):
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" 
  -H "Cookie: session=abc123;" 
  https://api.redwood.example/stream/submit
```
Response headers from their edge (customer provided):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: text/event-stream
transfer-encoding: chunked
cache-control: public, max-age=0
cf-cache-status: HIT
server: cloudflare
set-cookie: session=abc123; SameSite=None; Secure
```
Note: Vary header is missing for Authorization/Cookie so edge may cache a 200 and later serve a cached 304 or HIT.

devin: Interesting — Safari + Service Worker can rehydrate responses differently. There's a known behaviour where SSE delivered from a service-worker cache or an edge 304 may be buffered until tab focus or a buffer threshold is hit. :thinking:

sre-anna: Can you capture a HAR with preserve log and a pcap from the edge while reproducing? Also need the exact EventSource init options (credentials/etc).

lucas: Repro steps we gave customer:
1) Open private Safari window
2) Open devtools, enable "preserve log", register their SW
3) Navigate to app which uses EventSource with credentials 'include'
4) Observe: one or two events arrive, then silence ~12-30s, then client reconnects and we see CF respond with 304/HIT on subsequent requests.

frances: Can we see the minimal client code?

lucas: JS snippet they use:
```
const s = new EventSource('/stream/submit', { withCredentials: true });
s.onmessage = e => console.log('msg', e.data);
s.onerror = e => console.log('es error', e);
```
They also include `eventsource-polyfill` to support older Safari; polyfill falls back to XHR polling sometimes and causes double reconnects.

eng-runtime: Pinged. Two quick suspects: 1) edge is caching SSE responses (missing Vary: Authorization/Cookie), 2) token rotation leads to a mid-stream auth failure (401) that edge returns or caches incorrectly. We'll inspect our edge rules for SSE endpoints.

devin: Immediate workaround for customers: ensure SSE endpoints send `Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate` and include `Vary: Authorization, Cookie`. Also send periodic SSE comments (keepalive) like `: keepalive\\n\\n` every 15s so browsers don't consider the stream idle.

sre-anna: I'll apply a temporary origin-pass rule for that customer's route and enable debug headers so we can see if CF returned a cached object. Will also watch for repeats and file an incident if >5 occurrences in 1h.

support-bot: Linked internal ticket INC-5492 and uploaded the customer's HAR to the case.

frances: Can eng-runtime add a guard to ensure a 401 midstream can't become a cached 304 from the edge? If that's non-trivial, we'll document the header workaround for customers.

eng-runtime: We'll add a routing flag for stream endpoints to force origin-pass and treat responses from SSE endpoints as no-cache by default. Also adding checks so 401/403 responses are never cached. Will follow up in #eng-runtime with a patch.

lucas: Customer accepted the temporary bypass and is validating. Will update ticket if issues persist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
